verdict.rationale: Brex offers a business account with banking, so holding multi-currency balances is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence never documents holding or managing balances in more than one currency. Mentions of "fast global payments," "global corporate cards," and operating "in 120+ countries" are adjacent capabilities and do not show multi-currency balances held in one account. The Payments API lists only ACH, domestic wires, and checks.

support.subject: As a founder, I can hold and manage balances in multiple currencies from one account
